16903.d: Manor Farm, also known as the Farming Guild, is a farm located north of East Ardougne.

gt.heading: Getting there
gt.text:
• The Ardougne lodestone is located directly south-west of Manor Farm.
• If the medium Ardougne achievements have been completed, the Manor farm Teleport or the Ardougne cloak 2/3 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm once per day.
• If the elite Ardougne achievements have been completed, the Manor farm Teleport or the Ardougne cloak 4 can be used to teleport to Manor Farm without any daily limit.
• Skills necklace can be used to travel directly there.
• North Ardougne Teleport can be used to teleport there if the player doesn't have the Ardougne cloak but has Lunar Spells.
• Players with level 83 Farming can grow a spirit tree on the north-east side of Manor farm and then use the spirit tree network to teleport to and from the tree in the farm.

16933.d: A Maple Tree can be planted in the tree hotspot of the garden in a player-owned house.
16933.ex: A lovely addition to the garden.

16935.d: Maple trees grow on tree patches by planting maple saplings at level 45 Farming, giving 45 experience for planting the sapling and a further 3403.4 experience when the tree is fully grown.

16942.d: Maps is the name of a decorative centrepiece built in an aquarium's surface floor.
16942.ex: They don't love you like I love you.

16944.d: Marathon checkpoints could be found alongside marathon routes during the Gielinor Games.

16945.d: A marble altar is a piece of furniture that can be built in the chapel of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.

16946.d: A marble attack stone is the best stone that can be built in the games room in a player-owned house.
16946.ex: See how much damage you can do to it!

16947.d: The marble cape rack is a piece of furniture that can be built in the costume room of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16947.ex: A cape rack for you to hang your capes on.

16948.d: A marble door is a door that can be built in the dungeon of a player-owned house with the Construction skill.
16948.ex: Could anyone get through a solid marble door?

16949.d: A Marble fireplace is a piece of furniture used in the Construction skill.
16949.ex: A fire burns cosily in the grate.
